svg.title: Spatial intrinsic-structure decomposition and cross-focus research direction

g.text: Archived single-layer prototype outputs · real inspection images
Polar unfolding → robust harmonic fit → reconstruction and local response
A marks the same polar location; normal structure is retained while localized responses remain.
Mechanism foundation → cross-focus feature analysis and joint perception
Compare response strength and shape against normal focus evolution; persistence alone is insufficient.
Cross-focus crops and measured trajectories are pending source material; no synthetic curve is shown.
